mesh.evicts: Generating evicts instances kept warm: the first asset takes a while, then they reload.
mesh.fullHint: The generated mesh, simplified to the triangle count, with base colour, metallic and roughness. No normal map.
mesh.gameHint: A closed low-poly cage rebuilt from the outside of the mesh, with colour, material and a normal map baked onto it. Small openings are closed and painted on.
mesh.imageHint: One object, all of it in frame, on a plain background, for a single-view recipe (pixal3d). A transparent background is used as it is; any other is removed first.
mesh.needImage: Choose an image of the object.
mesh.viewsHint: Four views a quarter turn apart round the object, level with it, for a multi-view recipe (pixal3d-mv). The asset comes out upright, with the sides as the views show them.

out.viewerHint: Drag to turn, scroll to zoom.
